title: Your Claude Cowork Setup, Then a New Skill Every Week

sections.label: 1 - SETTING UP CLAUDE COWORK
sections.note: Claude runs on your own computer and works in one folder you choose, with your email, calendar and files connected. You can start using it the same day.

sections.label: 2 - YOUR FIRST SKILLS
sections.note: A skill is a set of saved instructions that Claude reuses, so you explain a task once and get the same result every time. We start with four everyday tasks and test each one on a real example.

sections.label: 3 - A NEW SKILL EVERY WEEK
sections.note: You said this is ongoing, so the list keeps growing. Each week you tell me which task took up your time, and it becomes the next skill.

nodes.label: 1 - We set up your Claude account on a plan that includes Cowork
2 - We install Claude on your computer and open Cowork
3 - You give Claude one folder for your notes, files and drafts
4 - We connect the email, calendar and files you already use
5 - You tell Claude once how you write and how you like to sign off
6 - Your first skill drafts a reply to every new inquiry
7 - Your second skill turns rough notes into a polished document
8 - Your third skill writes you a weekly summary of your inbox
9 - Your fourth skill turns your notes into a social post or newsletter
10 - We test each skill on a real example from your week
11 - Nothing sends on its own, so every draft waits for your OK
12 - Each week, the task that took up your time becomes a new skill
